use_case_name: Enter and Validate a Treatment Claim

claims.content: To capture and validate treatment claim submission details from the VSP for comparison with processed claims.

goal.raw_text: To capture and validate treatment claim submission details from the VSP for comparison with processed claims.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The VSP has submitted the Claim (Treatment form) to the MSIU Field office based on payment terms.
Mandatory information for claim submission is complete, including VSP Name, Date of submission, No of Mentioned Forms, No of Available Forms, Treatment Form No, and Transaction details.
Master data such as Referral Reason Master, Claim Quarantine / Rejection Reason Master, MSIU Treatment Matrix, and Syndrome details are configured in the system.
Staff Code with Suffix as VSP Code + SC + 3 digit is created and staff type is selected from Staff Type Master.
Vouchers have been created with unique identification numbers, security protocols, bar-codes, and project codes as per system generation rules.
The thumb impression from the patient has been obtained by VSP staff and stuck on the voucher slip on the claim form.
The VSP will send the collected claim forms monthly and send it to MSIU field office.

trigger.raw_text: The VSP will send the collected claim forms monthly and send it to MSIU field office.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User receives the collected claim forms from the VSP, which are sent monthly.
The system captures and validates mandatory submission details: VSP Name, Date of submission, No of Mentioned Forms, No of Available Forms.
The system captures Transaction part details including Treatment Form No.
The system ensures all above information’s are mandatory during submission entry.
The system sets Date of submission to current date as a design constraint.
The captured information is used for comparison with processed claims.
If any of mandatory information is missed or any false information is existing, then the field office will reject the claim back to VSP and the system will keep those claim in a quarantine area.
The quarantined forms will be sent back to the VSP for verification.
If the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims will be entered on to the system, in the following month’s batch.
If any of mandatory information is missed or any false information is existing, then the field office will reject the claim back to VSP and the system will keep those claim in a quarantine area.
The quarantined forms will be sent back to the VSP for verification.
System only accept claims only if the mandatory information is complete.
Claims are validated and entered into the system.
Rejected claims with missing or false mandatory information are kept in a quarantine area.
Based on payment terms agreed by VSP, the field office generates Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report and sends it to MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for the VSP.
MSIU Admin team collects client feedback from some clients and sends those documents to field office to enter into database.
